_readme: Andersen privacy glass for the customer screen — the five patterns Andersen carries. Photos (250×250, from Noble's energy-efficient windows page) live in assets/obscure/. Edit name, desc, and privacy here (1 = outlines still visible, 5 = detail gone). Do not invent a privacy number: leave privacy null until Nick sets it. Reed (3) and Satin Etch (5) still use the previous generic ratings — confirm them before treating them as final. placeholder:true shows the placeholder badge (Settings can hide badges). image is the photo shown on the card and in the clear-vs-pattern comparison; pattern is only a drawn fallback if image is missing. brand labels the group (add a Milgard group later with brand "Milgard" if those patterns come back). Order in this list is the order on screen.

patterns.name: Cascade
patterns.desc: Vertical water-streak texture. Light comes through; the view breaks into ripples.

patterns.name: Fern
patterns.desc: Pressed fern and leaf shapes across the glass.

patterns.name: Obscure
patterns.desc: A fine, even pebbled texture. The view softens into light.

patterns.name: Reed
patterns.desc: Vertical flutes. You get light and a soft sense of movement outside, not a clear view.

patterns.name: Satin Etch
patterns.desc: Even frosted etch. The strongest privacy here — light in, detail out.
